title: Log-less catch blocks in notifications swallow exceptions with no AppLogger trail (EH-3)

evidence.quote:
} catch (_) {
      // Some tests build notification providers without full sync dependencies.

} catch (_) {
      // Timezone re-detection failed — keep existing tz.local.

} catch (_) {
      // Platform query failed — leave tz.local as UTC rather than crash.

why: None of the three call AppLogger, so a real production failure is indistinguishable from the expected/benign case. The outbox-facade catch is the most consequential: it catches ANY exception from the whole outboxSyncWriteFacadeProvider dependency chain -- not just the 'test doesn't override this provider' case its comment describes -- and silently disables cloud sync of notification settings for that session with zero diagnostic trail.
recommendation: Log via AppLogger in all three; for the outbox-facade catch, narrow the caught condition so only the intended test-scaffolding case is swallowed and real errors are logged/propagated distinctly.
acceptance_criteria: Each catch gains a corresponding AppLogger call.
A grep for catch (_) { or catch (e) { in lib/features/notifications without a following AppLogger call in the same block fails CI.
